conflict_resolution_rule: The preregistration freezes metric names and componentwise decision logic but does not fully define every aggregation operator.
Where the two later pre-candidate documents disagree, the later and explicitly operationalizing METRIC_CONTRACT controls execution.
Where they do not disagree, both are compatible provenance.
No Reference metric values, candidate values, placement outcomes or comparator crossings were inspected to make this resolution.
